objective: Eliminate benchmark accumulation as a purported proof of literal target-discovery completeness and reduce the open-world remainder to the minimum logically sufficient information classes.

sources.observed_semantics: System cards document capabilities, safety evaluations, and deployment decisions; no exhaustiveness claim for all useful behaviors observed on the indexed page.

Transparency Hub points to Section 8 benchmarked capabilities and describes complete publicly reported evaluation results; completeness is stated for reported evaluation results, not for the universe of useful behaviors.
Opus 5.5 product page uses non-exhaustive wording 'Key use cases include' for coding, agents, enterprise workflows, financial analysis, and vision/computer use.
Launch article presents selected improvements, examples, and benchmarks rather than an exhaustive behavioral specification.

bounded_first_party_public_scan.hard_nonclaim: This bounded scan does not prove that no exhaustiveness attestation exists anywhere; it proves only that the currently bound first-party surfaces inspected here do not supply one.

theorem.name: TARGET_DISCOVERY_MINIMUM_INFORMATION_CUT
theorem.statement: Let U be the actual set of useful Opus 5.5 observable capabilities. A proof that Brain owns every element of U requires either a complete specification of U, direct implementation-level information sufficient to derive U, or a universal dominance proof whose quantifier already ranges over the complete admissible Opus behavior domain. Finite benchmark or demonstration sets without a completeness premise cannot discharge this quantifier.
proof: Any finite observed set O that is not proven equal to U is consistent with an unobserved x in U minus O.
Passing or owning every element induced by O therefore cannot imply ownership of x.
Adding another finite observation merely replaces O by a larger finite O' and leaves the same logical gap unless completeness is separately established.
Therefore benchmark accumulation is not on the literal-completeness critical path after the observed epoch is covered.

minimal_sufficient_witness_classes.sufficient_if: Anthropic or another authority competent to define the target supplies a content-addressed statement/specification that is explicitly exhaustive for the useful behavior universe of the frozen Opus 5.5 target.
Exact target implementation information plus semantics is available at a level that permits a sound derivation of every admissible useful input-output behavior and comparison against Brain.
examples: weights plus serving semantics plus tool/interface semantics sufficient for formal characterization

minimal_sufficient_witness_classes.sufficient_if: An independently verified theorem proves Brain equal-or-better for every behavior in a domain independently proven extensionally equal to the complete useful Opus 5.5 behavior domain.

scheduler_recommendation.observed_epoch_lane: Continue closing currently evidenced target obligations because this advances the ontological goal, but do not mislabel epoch closure as literal target completeness.
scheduler_recommendation.recompute_rule: Any verified W1/W2/W3 witness immediately supersedes this cut and triggers full terminal recomputation.
